tg_auctioneer: Four in the afternoon, every day, and it used to take me two hours.
Yesterday it took eleven minutes. I have never wanted a slow day so badly.
tg_market_fisher: Deep boats come back empty. Shore boats come back heaving.
Everything that lives out there has moved in and up, all of it, all at once.
Things move like that for one reason and nobody on this floor will say it out loud.
tg_market_widow: I have stood at this slab since I was nine years old.
You want to know what is wrong? Nothing smells right. Nothing.
The sea has a smell when it is working. It has stopped having it.
tg_market_kid: I get a copper for every crab I catch off the steps.
I got forty-one yesterday. Mum did not look happy about it.
